profile.name: Mawuli Badassou
profile.title: DevOps Engineer | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
profile.bio: Highly skilled and proactive DevOps Engineer with 2 years of experience and a strong background in backend development. Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and CloudFormation, with a proven track record of automating infrastructure provisioning and management on AWS. Expertise includes CI/CD pipeline implementation, configuration management, and monitoring & observability. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

experience.description: Engineering and implementing scalable AWS infrastructure with IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring solutions.
responsibilities: Engineered and implemented scalable, multi-environment AWS infrastructure using Terraform, importing over a dozen manually created resources into IaC
Automated post-provisioning configurations and environment variable management with Ansible, reducing manual effort and errors
Introduced and configured Prometheus and Grafana for production monitoring, enabling proactive resolution of a critical memory leak
Designed and deployed CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and CloudFormation templates for AWS-based backup solution
Contributed to high-stakes sprint building secure full-stack e-commerce infrastructure on AWS with focus on CI/CD pipelines and database security
Improved cost efficiency by extending automation scripts to schedule development/staging environment shutdowns
achievements: Successfully migrated 12+ manually created AWS resources to Infrastructure as Code
Enabled proactive monitoring that identified and resolved critical memory leak
Reduced compute costs through automated environment scheduling

experience.description: Developed backend services and full-stack applications using Python, Java Spring Boot, and Angular.
responsibilities: Developed backend services using Python and FastAPI, supporting application logic and troubleshooting
Collaborated on full-stack project with Java Spring Boot and Angular
Deployed applications on AWS EC2 and Vercel, gaining cloud deployment experience
Integrated external services including Google Maps API, Paystack, Amazon S3, and Holiday API
achievements: Delivered full-stack project with multiple third-party integrations
Improved collaboration skills through Agile methodology (Scrum)

experience.description: Completed AWS re/Start program and developed personal and group projects while earning AWS certifications.
responsibilities: Enrolled in and completed AWS re/Start program
Developed personal project using Java Spring Boot, Angular, GraphQL, and WebSockets
Deployed personal project using IaaS (AWS EC2) and PaaS (Vercel)
Collaborated on group project utilizing Agile methodology (Scrum)
achievements: Successfully deployed full-stack application to AWS and Vercel
Completed degree with focus on Computer Science fundamentals
